# awacino_beamin_code (Resource)

A Beam-in code for one of the company's Beam-in devices: a person or a machine with the code reaches exactly `reach` in the device's network (several networks: one code per network). Hand `connect_url` (or `code`) to your customer - both are returned **once**, on create, and are sensitive.

The code belongs to the company and is bound to the first device that redeems it. A code beyond the plan's active codes is created paused (`paused_reason = "lobby"`). Changing `device_id`, `reach`, `internet` or `valid_days` makes a **new code** (the old one is revoked). Destroying the resource revokes the code; a device connected with it is disconnected at once.

Needs the key section **Connections** (Write). API: `/v1/connections/beamin-codes`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "awacino_device" "web01" {
  name = "web-01"
}

# A Beam-in code for a customer: only remote login and HTTPS on this server, 30 days.
resource "awacino_beamin_code" "customer" {
  device_id   = data.awacino_device.web01.id
  label       = "Customer 4711 - web-01"
  external_id = "cust4711-web01-code"
  reach       = { kind = "ports", ports = [22, 443] }
  internet    = "none"
  valid_days  = 30
}

# Hand this to the customer (it is only known right after the code was created).
output "customer_connect_url" {
  value     = awacino_beamin_code.customer.connect_url
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `device_id` (String) The Beam-in device the code reaches.
- `reach` (Attributes) What the code reaches in the device's network. Changing it makes a new code. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--reach))

### Optional

- `expires_at` (String) End of the code (RFC 3339). It can later only move earlier.
- `external_id` (String) Your own id (unique per company among live codes, up to 128 characters).
- `internet` (String) Use the device's internet: `none` (default) never, `choice` the person decides, `full` always.
- `label` (String) Label shown in the app and the audit log, for example `Customer 4711 - web-01` (1-120 characters).
- `paused` (Boolean) `true` stops new connections and ends live ones; `false` resumes. Default `false`.
- `valid_days` (Number) Days the code works (1-365). Give this or `expires_at`; neither = no end where the plan allows it.

### Read-Only

- `bound_device` (Attributes) The device that redeemed the code first; only it can use the code. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--bound_device))
- `code` (String, Sensitive) The Beam-in code (16 characters). Known only on create; keep your state in an encrypted backend.
- `code_hint` (String) Last 4 characters of the code.
- `connect_url` (String, Sensitive) `https://www.awacino.com/beamin/#<code>` - opens the Awacino app with the code.
- `created_at` (String) When the code was created.
- `device_name` (String) Name of the Beam-in device.
- `id` (String) Code id (`bic_...`), never the code itself.
- `paused_reason` (String) `admin` (paused = true) or `lobby` (beyond the plan's active codes).
- `state` (String) `active`, `paused`, `expired` or `revoked`.
- `uses` (Number) How often the code was used.

<a id="nestedatt--reach"></a>
### Nested Schema for `reach`

Required:

- `kind` (String) `network` - the device and the whole network it sits in; `device` - this machine only; `ports` - only `ports` on this machine.

Optional:

- `ports` (List of Number) With `kind = "ports"`: the TCP / UDP ports (1-65535, at most 16).


<a id="nestedatt--bound_device"></a>
### Nested Schema for `bound_device`

Read-Only:

- `bound_at` (String) When it redeemed the code.
- `label` (String) Name the device reported.
- `platform` (String) Its platform.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# By code id (bic_...). The code itself is never importable.
terraform import awacino_beamin_code.customer bic_01JD41QH8Z9M2N4P6R8T0V2X4Y
```
